An '''outpost''' was established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taul/Legends|Taul]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to train soldiers for severe battle conditions. It was [[Battle of Taul|captured]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

==Description==
A small outpost established by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taul/Legends|Taul]] in the [[Gunthar system/Legends|Gunthar system]]<ref name="UG" /> of the [[Kriz sector/Legends|Kriz sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA-OC" /> The outpost was located on top of a cliff, which had only one land approach and three sides that had shear drops. The base consisted of a command center, and a [[Power generator/Legends|generator]] supplied power to two ground based anti-[[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]]. A defense grid of [[Mine/Legends|mines]] and traps surround the base. Twelve [[Starship/Legends|starships]] were stationed at the base for evacuation purposes.<ref name="UG" />

==Occupants==
The outpost was fully crewed by a command staff, and had a large number of Alliance troops on station either assigned to the base or in training. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Krendan]], a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], was assigned to the outpost, as was the [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Maidtha Fait]] and the quixotic [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Warl Thimbus]].<ref name="UG" />

==History==
The Alliance to Restore the Republic established the outpost on Taul to train their soldiers for severe battle conditions. Once the base was constructed, it was found that the ever-present fine mist in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was acidic in nature. While not harmful to organics, it caused mechanical problems for technological devices. The problem actually served to assist in the outpost's training function; due to the mist, the troops training on Taul were taught to be less dependent on [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and weapons were required to be disassembled and cleaned daily.<ref name="UG" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Timeline" /> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] deployed a large number of [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] in an attempt to discover the [[Echo Base/Legends|Rebel command base]]. One probe droid visited Taul, and the Empire lost contact with the droid, prompting them to send the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Dominator (Victory-class)|''Dominator'']] to investigate. Upon arrival, the ''Dominator'' began [[Battle of Taul|invading]] the planet. Due to the swampy conditions on the planet, the Imperials deployed [[attack droid]]s, [[battle skiff]]s, [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]]s, and dozens of troops. The Alliance defenders were smaller in number, but were better equipped and had the advantage of knowing the terrain.<ref name="UG" />

The battle raged for most of the day as the outpost was evacuated.<ref name="UG" /> Eventually, the base fell to the Imperial force, but not before several transports had fled the system with the ''Dominator'' in pursuit.<ref name="RT">{{JournalCite|2|Return to Taul}}</ref>
